crossRefs.note: “Foods for the belly, and the belly for foods,” but God will bring to nothing both it and them. But the body is not for…
for God’s Kingdom is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.
If you died with Christ from the elements of the world, why, as though living in the world, do you subject yourselves…
Don’t be carried away by various and strange teachings, for it is good that the heart be established by grace, not by…

translations.web: But food will not commend us to God. For neither, if we don’t eat, are we the worse; nor, if we eat, are we the better.
translations.bsb: But food does not bring us closer to God: We are no worse if we do not eat, and no better if we do.
translations.kjv: But meat commendeth us not to God: for neither, if we eat, are we the better; neither, if ➔ we eat not, are we the worse.
translations.asv: But food will not commend us to God: neither, if we eat not, are we the worse; nor, if we eat, are we the better.
